lines.t: So I gave myself five hundred dollars and thirty days to beat a casino. Which is a very smart plan made by a very smart person. Me.
Day one. I walk in and the first thing I notice is there are no clocks anywhere. Not one. I even checked the bathroom.
And I'm thinking okay that's weird but whatever because I have a system. <chuckle> I'm going to bet on red every single time.
Let me explain the system. If I lose I just bet again. And if I lose again I bet again. It's flawless.
Twenty minutes later I had eleven dollars.
That's not even enough for the drink they gave me for free. Which by the way is not free. Nothing in here is free. Even the carpet is designed to get you lost and I'm not joking. Look it up.
So this is the part where a normal person goes home. <laugh> I am not a normal person.
Hey hey hey stop looking at me like that. I still had a plan B.
